$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.haxe.types. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-ISOP-PARENS-DROPPED
arms.replace: return [for (e in guarded) { span: e.span, text: e.text }];
arms.note: the rewrite splices `x is T` bare, so `!Std.isOfType(a, B)` becomes `!a is B`, which reads `(!a) is B`

arms.name: M-ISOP-VALUE-ARGUMENT
arms.note: a second argument that is a value — a `Class<T>` parameter, a static field — is rewritten into a type position that reads a type of its name

arms.name: M-ISOP-STD-VALUE
arms.find:
span != null
			&& ValueDoors.bindsNoValue(receiver, name, span, fi, proof.root, proof.shape, proof.file, index)
arms.note: a local or field named `Std` is taken for the std type

arms.name: M-ISOP-COMMENT-DROPPED
arms.note: a comment between the call's arguments is deleted by the rewrite

arms.name: M-ISOP-SYNTAX-POSITION-REWRITTEN
arms.note: a call inside an annotation argument or a reification, read as syntax, is rewritten

arms.name: M-ISOP-VERSION-UNGATED
arms.note: a project declaring a language older than the operator is told to write it
